step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory
step1_figure.description: The circuit senses a resistive memory cell (Rmbit) using a first-order delta-sigma modulator. It integrates charge on the bitline capacitance (Cbit) using a switched-capacitor charge-dumping stage (M1–M3, Ccup), an isolation transistor (M4) to ensure linearity against bitline voltage variation, and a clocked comparator with built-in offset (Figure 17.16).

q_cup.description: Charge packet supplied by Ccup to the bitline during each enabled pulse

equation.explanation: Amount of charge dumped by Ccup when switched between VDD and VREF + |VTHP| through M4.
equation.assumptions: Complete settling of the switched-capacitor node; M4 source reaches VREF + |VTHP|.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Finite settling time and subthreshold conduction of M4 slightly adjust the effective charge per packet.

vref_limit.description: Upper limit of reference voltage VREF for valid charge dumping through PMOS M4

equation.explanation: If VREF >= VDD - |VTHP|, M4 cannot turn on and charge transfer Qcup drops to zero.
equation.assumptions: PMOS threshold voltage |VTHP| with zero substrate bias.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by PMOS threshold voltage on Sky130 1.8V process.

v_comparator_offset.description: Built-in offset voltage of the clocked comparator

equation.formula: Vos = V(In+) - V(In-) at decision threshold
equation.explanation: Offset created intentionally by sizing input device M10 wider than M1 (e.g., 13/1 vs 10/1) to provide reference offset without extra bias lines.
equation.assumptions: Differential pair sizing mismatch creates ~50 mV built-in offset.

sky130_expected.calculation: With NMOS input pair width ratio 1.3:1.0 (W_xm10=1.3u vs W_xm1=1.0u), built-in Vos ~ 30 mV to 60 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Slight variation with PDK process corners and threshold mismatch.

i_mbit.description: Average discharge current drawn through the resistive memory element

equation.explanation: The DSM loop regulates Vbit to VREF + Vos on average, driving current Vos / Rmbit through the memory resistor.
equation.assumptions: Loop settles to steady-state oscillation around VREF + Vos.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vos = 50 mV, Rmbit = 100 kΩ. Imbit = 0.05 V / 100 kΩ = 0.50 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the built-in comparator offset voltage.

delta_vbit.description: Bitline voltage step per single charge injection packet

equation.explanation: Voltage change on bitline capacitance Cbit due to charge conservation from Ccup packet.
equation.assumptions: Cbit >> Ccup, charge dumping completes before clock transition.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ccup = 100 fF, Cbit = 500 fF, VDD - VREF - |VTHP| = 0.88 V. Delta_Vbit = (100f / 500f) * 0.88 V = 0.2 * 0.88 V = 176 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Capacitive divider ratio Ccup / Cbit multiplied by effective driving step.

rsc_equivalent.description: Switched-capacitor equivalent feedback resistance when enabled every cycle (M = N)

equation.explanation: Effective resistance synthesized by Ccup switched at frequency fclk.
equation.assumptions: Non-overlapping two-phase clocking with complete settling.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined purely by capacitance Ccup and switching frequency.

rmbit_min.description: Minimum detectable resistance before feedback saturation (M = N)

equation.explanation: At Rmbit_min, DSM output is constantly high (M=N) to balance maximum discharge current.
equation.assumptions: Linear charge replenishment up to 100% duty cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vos = 50 mV, T = 10 ns, VDD - VREF - |VTHP| = 0.88 V, Ccup = 100 fF. Rmbit_min = (0.05 * 10e-9) / (0.88 * 100e-15) = 5.68 kΩ.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Defines the lower dynamic sensing limit for a given clock period.

vbit_average.description: Average steady-state bitline voltage held by delta-sigma feedback loop

equation.explanation: The closed-loop DSM modulation forces the bitline to oscillate around the comparator threshold.
equation.assumptions: Loop is stable and within linear sensing bounds.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Comparator offset Vos adds directly to reference voltage VREF.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench running a 100 MHz two-phase non-overlapping clock and comparator clock over 500 ns (50 cycles) to verify DSM bitline regulation, bitline ripple step, average bitline voltage, and charge injection dynamics.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DSM Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory (Baker Fig 17.18)
.lib "/home/designer/sky130_workspace/sky130A/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=2.0u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=2.0u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=2.0u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=4.0u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1.0u L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=1.0u L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=2.0u L_xm7=0.15u
.param W_xm8=1.0u L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=1.0u L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=1.3u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=1.0u L_xm11=0.15u
.param W_xm12=1.0u L_xm12=0.15u

VDD VDD 0 1.8
VREF VREF 0 500m

* Clocks: T = 10ns (100 MHz)
* phi1: active low charging M1
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10n)
* phi2: active low dumping M2
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 4.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10n)
* clock: comparator strobe active high
Vclk clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 8.0n 0.1n 0.1n 1.5n 10n)

* DUT from prompt
xm3 N001 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm1 N002 phi2 N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N004 N003 N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
C1 N001 0 1e-13
xm4 vbit VREF N004 N004 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
X_U1 vbit VREF N003 Out clock VDD 0 SUB_1
Cbit vbit 0 5e-13
R1 VREF vbit 100000.0

.subckt SUB_1 inp inm q qi clock VDD GND
  xm1 N003 inp GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
  xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
  xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
  xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
  xm10 N004 inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
  X_U1 Outp q qi VDD 0 NAND_2
  X_U2 qi Outm q VDD 0 NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

.control
tran 50p 500n uic

* Measure bitline voltages and ripple
meas tran vbit_max MAX v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
meas tran vbit_min MIN v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
meas tran vbit_avg AVG v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
let delta_vbit = vbit_max - vbit_min
print delta_vbit

* Comparator offset relative to VREF
let v_comp_offset = vbit_avg - 0.5
print v_comp_offset

* Current through Rmbit
let i_mbit = (vbit_avg - 0.5) / 100e3
print i_mbit

* Theoretical limits calculated from parameters
let vthp = 0.42
let vref_limit = 1.8 - vthp
let q_cup_ideal = (1.8 - 0.5 - vthp) * 1e-13
let rsc_eq = 1.0 / (1e-13 * 100e6)
let rmbit_min_calc = (v_comp_offset * 10e-9) / q_cup_ideal
print vref_limit q_cup_ideal rsc_eq rmbit_min_calc

quit
.endc
.end
